text:
lee: Quick bug: browser streaming sample throws on Stop sometimes: "Unexpected end of JSON input".
noah: steps?
lee: start long stream in /sse-sandbox, click Stop mid-stream ~30% runs. console shows JSON.parse on final chunk.
anya: sounds like partial SSE `data:` payload when fetch is aborted. Node shows similar when socket closes.
noah: proposal: treat user aborts as non-error — drop final incomplete chunk and emit `stream.aborted_by_user`. For network EOF, surface retryable error.
lee: temporary sample fix: add 50ms delay before calling abort to let buffers flush. reduces repro.
anya: I'll add unit tests that simulate truncated final chunk then socket close and assert parser emits `partial_dropped` metric instead of throwing.
ci-bot: Added test job to run on PRs.
noah: also add docs note on abort semantics and a small telemetry event to measure occurrence.
lee: cool, opening a small PR for parser change + tests.
